parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the event rule.

parameters.name: Targets
parameters.description: A list of event targets to create or update. For more information, see [Limits](~~163289~~).

sub_parameters.name: DeadLetterQueue
sub_parameters.description: The dead-letter queue (DLQ) to which events are sent after all retry attempts fail. Supported DLQ types include Message Queue for Apache RocketMQ, Message Service (MNS), Message Queue for Apache Kafka, and EventBridge.

sub_parameters.name: Endpoint
sub_parameters.description: The endpoint of the event target.

sub_parameters.name: ErrorsTolerance
sub_parameters.description:
The fault tolerance policy. Valid values:

- **ALL**: Enables fault tolerance. If an error occurs, execution continues. After the retry attempts defined by the retry strategy are exhausted, the event is sent to the configured dead-letter queue or discarded.

- **NONE**: Disables fault tolerance. If an error persists after all retry attempts fail, execution is blocked.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The custom ID of the event target.

sub_parameters.name: ParamList
sub_parameters.description: A list of parameters for the event target.

sub_parameters.name: PushRetryStrategy
sub_parameters.description:
The retry strategy for pushing events. Valid values:

- **BACKOFF\_RETRY**: The event is retried up to three times at random intervals between 10 and 20 seconds.

- **EXPONENTIAL\_DECAY\_RETRY**: The event is retried up to 176 times over 24 hours. The retry interval starts at 1 second, doubles with each attempt (1, 2, 4, ..., 256 seconds), and is capped at 512 seconds for all subsequent retries.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description: The type of the event target. For more information, see [Event target parameters](~~185887~~).
